# Third-party

`user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampax.github.com` is GNOME's own "User Themes" extension
(version 50.4, for GNOME 50), unmodified, from
https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gnome-shell-extensions. It is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later; see its
`COPYING`. It is included so the installer does not depend on extensions.gnome.org being reachable,
and is only installed when the computer does not already have it.
